lines.x: There is no need to worry yourself over my condition. I will strive to adapt to all minute physiological changes, and my work will not be impeded. I will continue to serve as your general physician.

The Sarcophagus's core device is precisely what keeps me alive, and for the time being I cannot move without it. This is a novel experience, paying close attention to my own condition. There are many matters I must re-familiarize myself with, and perhaps this time I will require your guidance.

With your combined effort to plot a course and lead Rhodes Island out of such dire straits, Amiya has grown into a mature leader, and I have never doubted Closure's talents or your strategic choices. We will not stop moving on account of one individual's departure—our losses, too, have shaped Rhodes Island into what we are today.

I am glad Mon3tr has managed to assimilate into Rhodes Island in her current form. She may be literally one-of-a-kind, but she is thankfully not alone here. She will not forget the duty we once carried on our shoulders, so you can trust her implicitly. She will stay by your side for much longer.

Priestess has handed her choice to you, and will not menace us for the time being. The Originium Incident has ripped open the wounds hidden by this land, and without a leader, despair could very well destroy us all before disaster has a chance to strike. No matter the era, civilization's greatest enemy has always been humanity itself.

Do you still feel lost, even now? One can only find meaning in one's existence provided a place to stand—life's inherent nature; but for me, that place is a duty, a commitment. I no longer question what my life is for, as the individual by the name of Kal'tsit has found herself at the end of her journey.

Thinking back on those farewells I could neither forget nor undo… I never expected a second shot at life. And I am grateful. The time that passed for me was something like a dream, while the rest of you were waiting in torment. Forgive me... you are correct, a parting like that would not be fair to anyone.

Our conversations will no longer be restricted, for I have no more secrets to hide from you. I will gladly share my experiences from past millennia, though I fear those thoughts and feelings will be hard to put into words. Very well, I will tell you as many stories as I can before the memories fade.

I will never forget what someone told me of life and love, and finally, I can give an answer with this body before it expires. I will patiently endure time's pressure on me, and stay true to my oath til my next and final death do us part.
Fortunately… this is not just another dream.
Dr. {@nickname}…?
Things will only get harsher in the future, so we ought to draw as much experience as possible.
You have many companions you can depend on. As a leader, you should get used to relying on them for your strength.
You no longer need my guidance, while Rhodes Island and this great land will have even greater need of you. Do not forget your initial matter of debate, Doctor: 'Find yourself.'
I can join the planning for our first-aid measures.
Sure thing.
Mon3tr, there is no need to worry. You're better off staying here to protect Doctor.
Minimize casualties, by all means. We must preserve every shred of hope left on this land.
Treatment preparations complete.
I trust you.
Wide-range healing unit deployed.
I'll keep the Operators safe. Focus on command.
Executing Ark Life Protocol.
Command: Restore.
Mon3tr, I need you to protect the wounded.
Don't be afraid, this power will only be used to heal.
Perhaps we'll manage to see it… the future that belongs to all the people.
No casualties reported.
The combat situation has been complicated, and we cannot avoid unexpected variables in our plans. But there are still ways to remedy them.
Let the others retreat first. Mon3tr, I need you to help me with the cleanup operation.
Same as it ever was.
You don't have to check up on me every minute, this body is no different to the others.
If my condition really does concern you, then I will tell you, I am fine.
Arknights.

New Year's has come again, and this time I feel the flow of time passing through my body. This is not dread, for the limitations of time are what make it valuable, and perhaps it is through experiences like these that I can live a more normal life. Dr. {@nickname}, I wish you good health in the new year.
I am here, Dr. {@nickname}.

Time has wiped away all traces of the world you once belonged to, and even the calendar system that once counted life's passage no longer exists. So, I would rather offer you my blessings the way people do on this great land. I hope it will grant you faith that even on your long and treacherous journey, you were and are never alone.

Rhodes Island's ideals have indeed united many. Even after suffering countless unbearable hardships, there are still those who yearn for a hopeful future. Regardless of whether we can truly overcome all of this suffering, the vision we carry on our shoulders ultimately belongs to all of Terra, and it ought to be remembered.
